verdict.rationale: First-party docs say agentic coding with Grok Build is available "on the API and CLI" [grok-docs-2]. A hands-on community user independently confirms Grok Build is "actually a very good CLI" [grok-comm-11], and another notes xAI now has "a real harness" [grok-comm-13]. missing for 10: in-depth CLI documentation (installation, commands, auth, scripting/non-interactive usage), and evidence that the CLI covers the broader API beyond agentic coding.
